stem.text: A sample of $17.15\,\text{mol}\ \text{HI(g)}$ is in dynamic equilibrium with $2.27\,\text{mol}\ \text{H}_2\text{(g)}$ and $2.84\,\text{mol}\ \text{I}_2\text{(g)}$ in a volume of $1\,\text{m}^{3}$ at $764\,\text{K}$ and $141\,\text{kPa}$.
Two equilibrium constants, $K_\text{c}$ and $K_\text{p}$, can be calculated for this mixture.
Which statements about the equilibrium constants for this mixture are correct?
